## Selected projects

- [SafeView](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/safeview): On-device visual phishing detection with OCR and semantic embeddings.
- [OvaLens Ecosystem](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/ovalens): Computer vision for duck-egg candling with ESP32 conveyor actuation.
- [Pickle World](https://www.ryleanthony-gabotero.tech/projects/pickleworld): Retired venue booking system using WebSocket locks and payment reconciliation.
